notes.list_status: Certified, and re-checked on 2026-08-27. The certified list read on 2026-08-24 was on the election page, every race under 'The following candidates have been certified as of 4:00 pm on August 24, 2026.'; the City has since taken the candidate accordions off that page and the slate now appears only on the Candidate Profiles page, which carries no certification banner of its own. Every name and every count survives the move unchanged - 10 mayoral, 14 at-large, 22 ward - so what is recorded here is still the certified list.
notes.source_note: candidate_list_url now points at 2026 Election Candidate Profiles, which is where the names went; the election page keeps the procedures and the 2022 material, links to it as 'Learn about the candidates', and holds no 2026 names at all. The profiles page calls itself opt-in - 'Every candidate for Mayor, Councillor and School Trustee is offered the option of submitting candidate profile information' - but the Clerk lists every certified candidate under the race headings whether or not they submitted anything, most with only a phone number and an email, and the totals match the certified accordions exactly, so it is the full slate rather than the subset who wrote a bio. tbayvotes.ca redirects to the election page and is not a separate source.
notes.parse_check: Different markup from the election page, and the nested-tag problem noted on 2026-08-11 and 2026-08-24 goes with it: here each name sits whole in one <td data-name="accParent"> cell, so 'Volker Kromm' and 'Stéphane Léonard Kuziora' come out intact. Two hazards replace it. Names are padded with   (' André Gagné', 'Tracey MacKinnon '), so they need unescaping and stripping. And one contact block - Peter Mark John Diedrich's - is marked accParent rather than accChild, so a parse that takes every accParent as a name returns 11 mayoral candidates; dropping the cells holding a phone number or an email gives the right 10.
notes.structure_match: The profiles page keeps the headings: 'At Large Councillor - Five (5) to be elected', and one '<Ward> Ward Councillor - One (1) to be elected' for each of the seven wards, confirming both structure-CSV rows including max_votes=5 for the at-large race. The mayoral heading is now a bare 'Mayor', without the '- One (1) to be elected' the election page carried. None of the headings has an id, so the '#At-Large-Councillor-Five-5-to-be-elected' anchor the structure CSVs use no longer resolves on either page.
notes.cross_race: Clinton Harris was a mayoral candidate on 2026-08-11 and is certified in the Westfort ward race instead.
notes.name_variant: The McKellar candidate is 'Donna Lee Morettin' on the City's nominee list of 2026-08-22 and on the certified list, and 'Donnalee Morettin' on the profiles page. The Clerk's spelling is the one kept. Profiles are 'posted verbatim with no changes', so the profiles-page spelling is the candidate's own, and it is also how the City indexed her 2022 financial statement; a re-collection from the profiles page alone will look like a diff here and is not one.
